entities.summary: Hüseyin Nâzım Pasha was an Ottoman Turkish general, who was the Chief of Staff of the Ottoman Army during the First Balkan War of 1912–13. He was murdered by Yakub Cemil during the 1913 Ottoman coup d'état.
